basic_profile.bio: Avid fantasy football enthusiast from Denver, Colorado. I spend most of my free time analyzing player stats and strategizing for my dynasty leagues. As a part-time IT consultant, I work flexible hours, which lets me enjoy my hobbies, including hiking in the Rockies and gaming. Currently single, I love connecting with fellow sports fans online, usually in the evenings and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge in fantasy sports, specifically dynasty football, built through years of participation and self-study. Regularly read sports analytics blogs and follow industry experts on social media. Also, tech-savvy due to my career in IT consulting.
